title: [SOLVED] Slow startup of Plasma 6.8 (again)
body: After the upgrade to Plasma 6.8 I have again issues with very slow startup time after login, as already happened with 6.4 and described here . But this time I disabled all the entries in the fstab, leaving only three like this one: 192.168.178.52:/home/nicola /mnt/conan/home nfs rw,user,noatime,noauto 0 0 which however having the `noauto` flag should not interfere. So I guess it's probably something different and not related to disk mount. Did someone else experience the same after upgrading to 6.8? Last edited by snack (2026-10-28 15:58:37)
